lines.zh: 我挪着小身子走，一颠一颠。
lines.en: I waddle along, bobbing with each step.

lines.zh: 我走一片叶子的宽度要半天。
lines.en: Crossing one leaf takes me half a day.

lines.zh: 我从草叶的缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out between blades of grass.
Step by step I move, very slowly.
I follow a crack in the soil.

lines.zh: 石子挡路，我从旁边蹭过。
lines.en: A pebble blocks me; I squeeze around it.

lines.zh: 我在草地上留下细细的痕。
lines.en: I leave a fine track on the grass.
I walk into the shade of the grass.
I must rest every little way.

lines.zh: 我顺着亮处，一步一步爬。
lines.en: I crawl toward the light, one step at a time.
I hop once and do not go far.
I squeeze past one of my own.
I stop beneath a blade of grass.
The sun reaches me and it is warm.

lines.zh: 旁边有几个和我一样的。
lines.en: A few like me are nearby.
I raise my eyes to you.
This body is small and soft.
A drop of water landed beside me.
I listen to the sounds in the grass.
I sway my sprout, then shrink back.
Seedling roots sink into soft soil.

lines.zh: 我一点点挪到石头边上。
lines.en: I edge over to the stone's rim.
Slowly I draw myself back.
A shadow lies across the grass.

lines.zh: 我转过身，朝另一个方向。
lines.en: I turn toward the other way.
I do nothing and stay.
You are far too large to me.
Even crouched you are taller.
I have just hatched.
I am not grown yet.

lines.zh: 你落脚之前，先看看草里。
lines.en: Look in the grass before you set that foot down.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，只看到你的鞋。
lines.en: I look up and see only your shoe.
There are many like me here.

lines.zh: 我饿了，可我不知道吃什么。
lines.en: I am hungry and do not know what to eat.

lines.zh: 这么小的芽，被你影子盖住。
lines.en: A sprout this small, covered by your shadow.
I will look different later.
Do not walk off. I am slow.

lines.zh: 我这一小团，掀不起什么。
lines.en: A little thing like me stirs nothing.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，一根手指就够。
lines.en: One finger could take me.
I raise my eyes to your hand.
Something else is moving in the grass.
It is fine here.
I am pinned underneath.
I rolled and went dizzy.
There is a small split on me.

lines.zh: 我翻过身来，喘了一口气。
lines.en: I roll over and take a breath.
I am still on the grass.

lines.zh: 疼得我把芽尖都卷起来。
lines.en: It hurts, and I curl even my sprout tip.
It hurts, but I can still move.
I stand crooked a while.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记进软软的身子里。
lines.en: I write this blow into my soft little body.

lines.zh: 疼过之后，我又蹭了一步。
lines.en: After the pain, I creep one step on.

lines.zh: 我从数码蛋里钻出来，只有两点生命。
lines.en: Out of a Digitama with two health.
I am a seed, not yet sprouted.

lines.zh: 这味道，不像幼年期饲料。
lines.en: This smell isn't like young-stage feed.
I touch it. It is hard.
It's so hard my little teeth ache.

lines.zh: 我咬下一小口，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I nibble a corner and hold it in my mouth.
Too big. Bigger than I am.
That much would last me a while.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我踮脚也够不着。
lines.en: Kneel down — even on tiptoe I can't reach.
I will not eat. I am not hungry.
Afterward I will still sleep.
I smell something sweet.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩下来，我差点没了。
lines.en: Your foot came down and I nearly vanished.

lines.zh: 我被碰得在土上打了个滚。
lines.en: The nudge sends me rolling over the dirt.
I right myself again.
You touched the grass and it touched me.
I roll behind a pebble to hide.
So little weight I make no sound.
Your shoe tip touched me.
I shift away from your foot.
That left me dizzy a while.
I crawl back to my place.

lines.zh: 这里有许多像我一样的。
lines.en: There are many like me here.

lines.zh: 我们这些小芽挤成一堆。
lines.en: We little sprouts huddle in a heap.
None of us knows another.
One is right against me.

lines.zh: 我们挤在暖石头上一起晒。
lines.en: We crowd onto a warm stone to sun.

lines.zh: 它们的颜色比我深一点。
lines.en: They are a shade darker than I.

lines.zh: 我们不会留在一起太久。
lines.en: We will not stay together long.

lines.zh: 有一天我会变成另一个样子。
lines.en: One day I will become something else.

lines.zh: 那时我就不认得它们了。
lines.en: Then I will not know them.
For now the crowding keeps us warm.
A tiny crumb on the ground.

lines.zh: 我用两只小手捧起一粒。
lines.en: I cup a single grain in both hands.
Too heavy to lift.
It rolled to my feet.
I bite a little. It is edible.
I look like a tiny seed.
This bright thing I do not understand.
A torn leaf lies beside me.
I push it a short way.
It dropped and I let it be.
Something small is moving ahead.

lines.zh: 我贴着土缝，一点点蹭过去。
lines.en: I inch along a crack in the soil.
It looks sturdier than I.

lines.zh: 我抬起小脑袋，认出了它。
lines.en: I lift my small head and make it out.
A few steps cover it.

lines.zh: 它低头找食，没看见草里的我。
lines.en: It grazes, never seeing me in the grass.
I go round behind a grass blade.
I stopped to give you a chance.
It has moved on.
It takes a step; I creep half an inch.
My scent will be caught first.
It does not seem to mind.
Belly to the dirt, I crawl slowly.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就缩回草叶下。
lines.en: Each time it moves, I duck under a leaf.
It is faster, and has not noticed.
I wait for it to come nearer.
A grass blade hides half of me.
A little closer and I can reach.

lines.zh: 它的影子一压下来，我就停。
lines.en: Its shadow falls, and I stop dead.
I freeze, not even my sprout tip moving.
It looked down.

lines.zh: 我把小身子贴进草影里。
lines.en: I press my little body into the grass shadow.
It looked a while, then left.
I follow quietly.
I hop up and bump it.

lines.zh: 我这一撞，只够碰歪一片草。
lines.en: My charge only bends a blade of grass.
I blow out a bubble.
It popped and left nothing.
One more shove, just to try.
It stepped back, out of irritation.
I fall and roll.
I roll upright and bump into it again.
This is all the strength I have.
I am tired. I stop.
It looks down at me and does nothing.
So we stand facing each other.
I hatch out of a Digitama.
Bits of shell are still on the ground.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，我先看见草尖。
lines.en: The shell cracks and the first thing I see is a grass tip.
I move and cannot quite stand.
This grass is my beginning.

lines.zh: 旁边有几个和我一起出来的。
lines.en: A few came out with me.
I shuffle half a step from the broken shell.
Sunlight is on me.
I do not have a name yet.
I look up at the grass around me.
I am hungry and do not yet know how to look.
I stay where I am for now.
The heat made me shrink small.
I fell off the stone.
A drop of water trapped me.
The blast blew me far.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过，刮掉我一点皮。
lines.en: An arrow grazes me and scrapes off a bit of skin.
Strange light closes over me entirely.
I grow smaller and lighter.

lines.zh: 雷声让我整个缩起来了。
lines.en: The thunder made me fold up.
The ground went and I am falling.
